name: personhood
breaks_up: a piece of work in which language work and judgement work are both in play, by who holds each part of it
left_out: Personhood for things. A model and code are things: they hold a part only as tools a person set up, and have no personhood. Personhood is partial for an animal: it holds intent and no other part, because language, judgement and residue are written or ruled, and an animal's signals are read for structure, never translated.

element_types.name: intent
element_types.description: What the work is for. It comes first and stays with the person doing the work; the sentence that states it is never a model's.

elements.name: an animal
elements.description: the animal whose life it is; it holds its own intent, which nobody states for it, neither a model nor a person. An animal holds intent and no other part, so its personhood here is partial

elements.name: other people
elements.description: people other than the one doing the work

elements.name: a model under negotiation
elements.description: a thing, not a person: a model, holding this part only where that was negotiated and set up for this work, its answers held by code

elements.name: code
elements.description: a thing, not a person: rules fixed in advance as a written standard and run as a program anyone bound by them can read
